message.content:
Sure! Here’s a quick guide on how to post that comment to VirusTotal using your API key.

### 1. Endpoint
```
POST https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/comments
```

### 2. Headers
```http
x-apikey: YOUR_API_KEY
Content-Type: application/json
```

Replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with your actual key (`XYZ789` in your example).

### 3. Request Body
```json
{
  "type": "comment",
  "attributes": {
    "text": "Needs review #unsure"
  }
}
```

### 4. Full cURL Example
```bash
curl -X POST "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/comments" \
     -H "x-apikey: XYZ789" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{
           "type": "comment",
           "attributes": {
             "text": "Needs review #unsure"
           }
         }'
```

### 5. Using Python (requests library)
```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/comments"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": "XYZ789",
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
}
payload = {
    "type": "comment",
    "attributes": {
        "text": "Needs review #unsure"
    }
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)
print(response.status_code)
print(response.json())
```

### 6. Verify the Comment
After posting, you can retrieve the comment list for the IP `10.0.0.1` to confirm it was added:

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/10.0.0.1/comments
```

Just add the same `x-apikey` header.

That’s all you need to do! Let me know if you run into any issues.
